messages:
emma: Quick status — PR #4923 ready for docs review and merge. Includes SDK snippet for streaming and migration note. Need to coordinate merge with next deploy. Preview: (pending). Who can review today? @sam @marta :hourglass:

sam: I can review after lunch, ETA 2pm PT. Is there a release freeze window?

rui: Heads up: release freeze 08:00-10:00 UTC tomorrow for DB migration. If merge happens during rollback window, routing may change. Recommend merging after 10:15 UTC.

marta: FYI netlify preview failed for me — 500 on /docs/sdks/node/migrate. Re-running CI should fix. error: `404 /static/js/main.*.js`

ci-bot: netlify-preview: build started for PR #4923 — preview URL: https://deploy-preview-4923--redwood-docs.netlify.app (will update when done)

sam: I'll do a quick pass on the text and SDK snippet. Need to confirm `stream=true` sample is accurate for the Node SDK change. @emma can you paste the snippet here?

emma: snippet:
```js
const res = await client.generate({model: 'rwd-3b', input: prompt, stream: true});
for await (const msg of res.stream()) { console.log(msg); }
```
Also added migration note under /docs/migrate/v1-to-v2 — it's versioned.

marta: the snippet looks fine but update `client.generate` -> `client.responses.create` per API v2. Also add `timeout` note for streaming. I can amend after your go-ahead.

emma: ack — please patch. Also need to ensure we don't merge until feature flag `responses_v2` is enabled in prod. Jules, any ETA on the flag? @jules

jules: flag rollout starts at 09:30 UTC tomorrow, ramp to 100% by 11:00 UTC. We can merge after 09:45 UTC if we want gradual exposure. If you prefer, wait until 11:05 to avoid partial users.

rui: prefer merging after 11:05 UTC given DB migration + flag ramp. That gives rollback buffer.

sam: OK I'll review now, mark as approved if change is only method name. @marta please push the minor edit.

marta: pushed fix in PR (force-push) — changed to `client.responses.create` and added `timeout` note. CI re-run.

ci-bot: netlify-preview: build succeeded — preview: https://deploy-preview-4923--redwood-docs.netlify.app
CI: docs-preview passed, lint passed, sdk-snippets-check passed.

emma: thanks! I'll hold merge until 11:10 UTC tomorrow and then merge to main, trigger docs deploy. Can someone set the PR merge window note in the release doc? I'll add in release notes that docs depend on feature flag.

sam: added a line in release doc: `docs PR #4923 merge window: 11:10 UTC (post-flag ramp)`

jules: noted. ping me 5m before merge so I can verify flag state.

emma: will do. Thanks all :tada:
